name: buildermesh
description: The operator skills (ideate, choose-ideas, build, scaffold, mesh-status: the chat entry points to the build lifecycle; sync and prune across boxes) and the lead, executor, ideate-engineer and ideate-ux skills for nodes on a buildermesh mesh: delegation shape, checkpoints, branch hand-back, the verified line and the proposal round, over the bmesh CLI; and a session hook that says which box a session runs on (bmesh hosts --here).
